name: Rio Hondo College Dual Enrollment
what_you_do: Take Rio Hondo College classes while you are still in high school and earn college credit.
who_can_apply: High school students and adult high school students. A principal or school designee must sign your petition. K to 8 students can also apply with a principal's letter.
pay_detail: Enrollment and student fees are waived.
deadline_text: Winter 2027 and Spring 2027 petition forms are posted as of Nov 3, 2026. No due date is listed. Check the college Academic Calendar for term dates.
how_to_apply: Apply online each semester. Do the Parent Authorization Form. Send a Petition for Dual Enrollment each semester. Do placement if your class needs it. Then register with the class numbers. Call (562) 463-4693.
notes: Math, English, reading and classes with prerequisites need placement. You can send your transcripts to dual enrollment staff or use the online tool.
